questions.question: Tell me about yourself
questions.question_ko: 자기소개를 해주세요
tips: End with why you're interested in this role
follow_up_questions: What made you interested in this field?
Tell me more about your recent project

questions.question: Tell me about a time when you faced a difficult challenge at work
questions.question_ko: 업무에서 어려운 도전에 직면했을 때에 대해 말해주세요
tips: Use STAR method (Situation, Task, Action, Result)
follow_up_questions: What would you do differently?
How did this experience change your approach?

questions.question: Describe a situation where you had to work with a difficult team member
questions.question_ko: 어려운 팀원과 함께 일해야 했던 상황을 설명해주세요
follow_up_questions: What did you learn from this experience?
How do you handle conflicts now?

questions.question: What are your greatest strengths?
questions.question_ko: 당신의 가장 큰 강점은 무엇인가요?
follow_up_questions: How have these strengths helped you succeed?
Can you give me a specific example?

questions.question: What is your greatest weakness?
questions.question_ko: 당신의 가장 큰 약점은 무엇인가요?
tips: Explain how you're working to improve
follow_up_questions: What steps are you taking to improve?
How has this affected your work?

questions.question: How would you handle a situation where you disagree with your manager's decision?
questions.question_ko: 상사의 결정에 동의하지 않는 상황을 어떻게 처리하시겠습니까?
follow_up_questions: What if they still disagree?
Have you had this experience before?

questions.question: Where do you see yourself in five years?
questions.question_ko: 5년 후 자신의 모습을 어떻게 보시나요?
follow_up_questions: What steps will you take to get there?
How does this role fit into your plan?

questions.question: Why do you want to work for our company?
questions.question_ko: 우리 회사에서 일하고 싶은 이유는 무엇인가요?
tips: Connect your values with company values
follow_up_questions: What do you know about our products?
What attracts you to our industry?

questions.question: Why should we hire you?
questions.question_ko: 왜 우리가 당신을 채용해야 하나요?
follow_up_questions: What makes you different from other candidates?
What will you bring to the team?

questions.question: Tell me about a time when you had to learn a new technology quickly
questions.question_ko: 새로운 기술을 빠르게 배워야 했던 경험에 대해 말해주세요
follow_up_questions: How do you typically learn new things?
What resources did you use?

questions.question: Explain a complex technical concept to a non-technical person
questions.question_ko: 복잡한 기술 개념을 비기술자에게 설명해주세요
follow_up_questions: How do you ensure they understand?
Give me another example

questions.question: Describe a situation where you had to debug a critical production issue
questions.question_ko: 중요한 프로덕션 이슈를 디버깅해야 했던 상황을 설명해주세요
follow_up_questions: How did you prevent similar issues?
What was the impact on users?

questions.question: Tell me about a time when you had to persuade others to see your point of view
questions.question_ko: 다른 사람들을 설득해야 했던 경험에 대해 말해주세요
follow_up_questions: What resistance did you face?
How did you build consensus?

questions.question: Describe a situation where you had to make a difficult business decision
questions.question_ko: 어려운 비즈니스 결정을 내려야 했던 상황을 설명해주세요
follow_up_questions: What data did you consider?
Would you make the same decision again?

questions.question: How would you handle a situation where a project is behind schedule and over budget?
questions.question_ko: 프로젝트가 일정보다 지연되고 예산을 초과하는 상황을 어떻게 처리하시겠습니까?
follow_up_questions: What would you do differently?
How would you communicate this to stakeholders?

questions.question: Tell me about a successful campaign you led or contributed to
questions.question_ko: 성공적으로 이끌거나 기여한 캠페인에 대해 말해주세요
follow_up_questions: What made it successful?
What challenges did you face?

questions.question: How do you measure the success of a marketing campaign?
questions.question_ko: 마케팅 캠페인의 성공을 어떻게 측정하나요?
follow_up_questions: What tools do you use?
How do you report results?

questions.question: Tell me about a time when you lost a sale. What did you learn?
questions.question_ko: 판매에 실패한 경험에 대해 말해주세요. 무엇을 배웠나요?
follow_up_questions: How did you bounce back?
What would you do differently?

questions.question: How would you handle an angry customer who is threatening to cancel their contract?
questions.question_ko: 계약을 취소하겠다고 위협하는 화난 고객을 어떻게 처리하시겠습니까?
follow_up_questions: What if they still want to cancel?
How would you prevent this situation?

questions.question: Describe a time when you had to work under tight deadlines
questions.question_ko: 촉박한 마감일 내에 일해야 했던 경험을 설명해주세요
follow_up_questions: How do you manage stress?
What tools helped you?

questions.question: Tell me about a time when you failed and what you learned from it
questions.question_ko: 실패한 경험과 그로부터 배운 것에 대해 말해주세요
tips: Show how you applied the lesson
follow_up_questions: How did this change your approach?
What would you do differently?

questions.question: Describe a situation where you had to take initiative
questions.question_ko: 주도적으로 행동해야 했던 상황을 설명해주세요
follow_up_questions: What motivated you to take initiative?
How was it received?

questions.question: Tell me about a time when you had to balance technical debt with new feature development
questions.question_ko: 기술 부채와 새로운 기능 개발의 균형을 맞춰야 했던 경험에 대해 말해주세요
follow_up_questions: How did you decide what to prioritize?
What was the outcome?

questions.question: How would you handle receiving critical feedback from a colleague?
questions.question_ko: 동료로부터 비판적인 피드백을 받는 것을 어떻게 처리하시겠습니까?
follow_up_questions: Can you give me an example?
How do you typically respond to criticism?

questions.question: Describe a situation where you had to lead a team through a major change
questions.question_ko: 팀을 큰 변화로 이끌어야 했던 상황을 설명해주세요
follow_up_questions: What resistance did you encounter?
How did you maintain morale?
